comparison.objective: Seat a shower cartridge against O-ring resistance and install its retaining U-clip; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block from rail to jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record holds a springing cartridge flush while the other hand inserts a clip. Candidate holds a jig flush and parallel while the other hand advances a block across a support boundary, preserving four free-ball circuits.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires flush cartridge seating, fully inserted clip and retention under a 20 N pull. Candidate requires full transfer with every ball contained and no gap, inclination, jam or damage.
comparison.reason: This is the closest bimanual hold-while-advancing pattern, but clip insertion creates final retention, whereas the candidate tests continuous support of freely moving rolling elements throughout a rail-to-jig handoff.
